newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - RADIO NOON HEADLINES - MAY 7.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - RADIO NOON HEADLINES - MAY 7.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Wednesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Tonis Lukkas, the former mayor of Tartu who was recently replaced by a no-confidence vote, wishes to become a school teacher.
- Jaan Toots, the sacked former permanent under-secretary of the interior ministry, is waiting for new job offers.
